shared_elements: large raptor/vulture-like bird with heavy hooked beak
bird shown in profile with rounded head
wing/plumage rendered as rows of parallel ridges or lines
bird with long neck and pointed beak (lower part of B / general avian repertoire)
justification: Both depict a heavy-bodied raptorial bird with a strongly hooked beak whose plumage is conveyed by rows of parallel ridges, a reasonably specific shared motif rather than a generic 'bird'. However, A is a single isolated figure in the round with no scene, while B is a multi-register composition with a row of animals above a zigzag band, a bird with an outstretched wing over a disc, small subsidiary creatures and a long-necked bird below, so relationships and arrangement scarcely correspond.
